Semantic radar needs more MAP space.

Central Ingress & Post-MFA Handoff Bridge

  • External OIDC/OAuth2/SAML callbacks terminate on api.scripe.org without touching client sessionStorage
  • PostMfaHandoffHelper & TenantOriginOwnershipValidator mint post-MFA 120s SHA-256 handoff tickets after Verify2FA
  • VerifiedOriginEvaluator caches active non-suspended custom tenant hosts for 60s

HMAC Relay, Rate-Limit & Dual-RP Safety

  • SessionRelayAuthenticator validates 30s skew, 60s nonce, and partitions rate limits by X-Scripe-Session-Relay-Client-Ip
  • CookieAuthMiddleware.Relay emits X-Scripe-Relay-Refresh-MaxAge (0 when staySignedIn=false) for BFF cookie parity
  • WebAuthn:UserVerification='required', PasskeyAuthLimit=12/15m, and 0-error --idempotent PG 18 / SQL 2025 / Oracle 21c XE parity

Sibling-JTI Revoke & Split Logout

  • RevokeAllSessionsCommandHandler preserves caller's active refresh session and blacklists sibling JTIs
  • AuthLogoutScopeHelper preserves scr.oidc.session during /refresh, /sso/handoff, and 'app' logouts
  • OidcLoginController blocks cross-site GET ~/oidc/logout (403 OIDC_LOGOUT_CSRF_BLOCKED) and requires POST
